service.description: One request to the DAV server at /dav, as a device would send it, for a spec or a script that checks a DAV adapter: the request runs in an execution context of its own, as on a request worker (authorization on), and logs in by its own Authorization header (Basic, with an app password) as over HTTPS; the caller's user and context are untouched.

parameter.name: headers
parameter.description: Name to value, such as Authorization and Depth

service.description: Where the current user's devices sync (a Sync settings screen): the DAV server's address (dav-server public-url, else the webapp host and port) and the user's homes on it, whether CalDAV and CardDAV are served (an application names their adapters), and the SFTP address of the drives when the SSH server takes them; with driveId, that drive's WebDAV folder and SFTP path, named as those servers name it.

parameter.name: serverHost
parameter.description: Host and port, the server name a phone's account form asks for

parameter.name: calendarsUrl
parameter.description: Empty when no CalDAV adapter is named

parameter.name: addressBooksUrl
parameter.description: Empty when no CardDAV adapter is named

parameter.name: sftpUrl
parameter.description: Empty when the SSH server is off or dav-server sftp-drives is false

parameter.name: driveUrl
parameter.description: With driveId: the drive's WebDAV folder; empty when the user may not open it

parameter.name: driveSftpPath
parameter.description: With driveId: the drive's folder over SFTP
